svg.title: Synthetic demonstration: one star
svg.desc: Star history for Synthetic demonstration: one star over all time. 1 current stars. 1 recorded additions in range. 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-14. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges. Some weeks had no recorded data and were treated as zero.
